correctness.rationale: Both directions of the phase-lock formula were reconstructed. A rational relation gives \(v=a-t\alpha\) with constant phase \((-1)^t\); conversely the carry identity \(2A_n-A_{2n}=v\cdot\beta\) forces an integer coefficient, after which the relation is recovered coordinatewise. The map is injective by rational independence. The two-copy translated cancellation gives a nonzero bounded Fourier annihilator on arbitrarily small sets, and standard duality yields incompleteness for every finite \(p\).
